name: CM Raitha Vidya Nidhi — Scholarship for Farmers' Children (Karnataka)
description: Karnataka Agriculture Department scholarship for children of farmers and agricultural labourers who study after Class 10 (PUC, ITI, diploma, degree, PG, PhD). The parent farmer's land is checked through the state FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) database, so the parent must have a FRUITS ID. There is no family income limit. Students who failed or repeat a year are not eligible. Applications go through the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP). The last date changes every year; secondary sources mention 31 Dec 2026, which is NOT confirmed. Helpline 1800 425 3553.
benefits: Yearly amount paid by DBT; it depends on course level and gender, with girls getting more. Secondary sources report ₹2,500 to ₹11,000 a year; confirm the exact amount for your course on the portal.
source_organization: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka (applications on SSP)
required_documents: FRUITS ID of the parent farmer (land must be registered)
Admission proof and fee receipt for the current course
Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked bank account of the student
